subject: Plank floor
descriptionEn: A top-down square swatch of installed wooden plank flooring: five wide parallel warm oak boards joined edge to edge, staggered short end joints, subtle dark grain and a few small nailheads. This is a FLAT WALKABLE FLOOR SURFACE, not a stack of lumber, not loose boards, not a table. Square block fills 28x28 logical pixels, dark perimeter outline and four logical pixel transparent outside margin; do not tilt the square.
